info.title: Fenergo Nebula Reports Command
info.description:
**Reports Command API**:

**Reports Command API provides**:

post.summary: Upload a tenant report branding logo
post.description:
• Accepts a multipart upload of a PNG or SVG logo file (max 500 KB).
  • Streams the file directly to the tenant's S3 document-management bucket from the API (no browser-direct S3 PUT, so no bucket CORS dependency).
  • Returns the S3 key the logo was stored under, which the caller should then submit to `PUT /api/v2/report-branding` to persist the branding configuration.


Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ReportingEdit

pdfFooter.description: Text content placed in the footer of generated PDF reports.

reportId.description:
Identifier of the report whose insight the user is rating.
Must be a non-empty, GUID-compatible string that belongs to the requesting tenant.

conversationId.description:
Identifier of the insights conversation that produced the rated insight.
Must be a non-empty, GUID-compatible string.

rating.description:
Thumbs-up / thumbs-down signal.
Accepted values: `"useful"` or `"notUseful"` (case-insensitive).

feedbackText.description:
Optional free-text explanation provided by the user.
Maximum 2,000 characters; plain text only (no HTML).
Treated as sensitive tenant data.
feedbackText.example: The risk rating distribution chart was exactly what I needed.

insightMessageId.description:
Optional identifier for a specific insight message within the conversation,
allowing per-turn feedback when conversations later support multiple insight turns.

insightSummary.description:
Optional short non-sensitive summary of the rated insight for future tenant-memory retrieval.
The canonical memory payload stores this summary instead of raw report rows.

chartSuggested.description:
Indicates whether a chart suggestion was present in the rated insight.
Provides an analytics dimension without requiring the backend to inspect the payload.

storeInTenantMemory.description:
Controls whether the feedback should be written into tenant-scoped long-term agent memory.
When `null`, the behaviour is determined by the tenant/operational configuration
(enabled by default until `AgentInsights:EnableTenantMemory` is disabled).
